commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP1: prepare backing store dir"
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/lvm-backing

echo "STEP2: create sparse backing file (1200MiB, under 2G on purpose)"
sudo -n truncate -s 1200M /var/lib/lvm-backing/srvdata.img

echo "STEP3: attach loop device"
sudo -n losetup -f /var/lib/lvm-backing/srvdata.img
LOOPDEV=$(sudo -n losetup -j /var/lib/lvm-backing/srvdata.img | cut -d: -f1)
echo "loop device is $LOOPDEV"
echo "$LOOPDEV" | sudo -n tee /var/lib/lvm-backing/loopdev.txt

echo "STEP4: pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate"
sudo -n pvcreate -f "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n vgcreate vgdata "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n lvcreate -n lvdata -l 100%FREE vgdata

echo "STEP5: mkfs.xfs"
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /dev/vgdata/lvdata

echo "STEP6: mountpoint + fstab (create systemd unit to reattach loop at boot before lvm activation)"
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
UUID=$(sudo -n blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/vgdata/lvdata)
echo "fs UUID=$UUID"

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/attach-lvm-backing-loop.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device for /srv/data LVM backing file
DefaultDependencies=no
Before=lvm2-activation.service local-fs-pre.target sysinit.target
After=systemd-udevd.service local-fs.target
Wants=systemd-udevd.service
ConditionPathExists=/var/lib/lvm-backing/srvdata.img

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup -f /var/lib/lvm-backing/srvdata.img
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target
UNIT

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable attach-lvm-backing-loop.service

grep -q "$UUID" /etc/fstab || echo "UUID=$UUID /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=attach-lvm-backing-loop.service,x-systemd.requires=lvm2-activation.service 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "STEP7: mount"
sudo -n mount /srv/data
mount | grep /srv/data

echo "STEP8: write test data + record checksum"
sudo -n sh -c 'dd if=/dev/urandom of=/srv/data/testfile.bin bs=1M count=50 status=none'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo "hello lvm world $(date)" > /srv/data/marker.txt'
sudo -n sh -c 'find /srv/data -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort | xargs md5sum' | sudo -n tee /var/lib/lvm-backing/baseline.md5

echo "STEP9: baseline sizes"
df -h /srv/data
sudo -n lvs vgdata
sudo -n vgs vgdata
sudo -n pvs "$LOOPDEV"

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
LOOPDEV=$(cat /var/lib/lvm-backing/loopdev.txt)
echo "using loop dev $LOOPDEV"

echo "STEP1: pre-grow verification of mount + checksum"
mount | grep /srv/data
sudo -n sh -c 'find /srv/data -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort | xargs md5sum' > /tmp/pre_grow.md5
diff /var/lib/lvm-backing/baseline.md5 /tmp/pre_grow.md5 && echo "CHECKSUM OK pre-grow"

echo "STEP2: extend backing file to 2560MiB"
sudo -n truncate -s 2560M /var/lib/lvm-backing/srvdata.img
ls -lh /var/lib/lvm-backing/srvdata.img

echo "STEP3: refresh loop device size"
sudo -n losetup -c "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n losetup -l "$LOOPDEV"

echo "STEP4: pvresize"
sudo -n pvresize "$LOOPDEV"
sudo -n pvs "$LOOPDEV"

echo "STEP5: lvextend to consume all free space"
sudo -n lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/vgdata/lvdata
sudo -n lvs vgdata

echo "STEP6: grow xfs filesystem online (still mounted)"
mount | grep /srv/data
sudo -n xfs_growfs /srv/data

echo "STEP7: post-grow verification"
df -h /srv/data
sudo -n lvs --units g vgdata
mount | grep /srv/data
sudo -n sh -c 'find /srv/data -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort | xargs md5sum' > /tmp/post_grow.md5
diff /var/lib/lvm-backing/baseline.md5 /tmp/post_grow.md5 && echo "CHECKSUM OK post-grow, data intact"

LVSIZE_BYTES=$(sudo -n blockdev --getsize64 /dev/vgdata/lvdata)
echo "LV size bytes: $LVSIZE_BYTES"
python3 -c "print('LV size GiB:', $LVSIZE_BYTES/1024/1024/1024)"
